head.title: Chef Training Academy Dubai | myCHEF Dubai
head.meta_description: myCHEF Dubai's Chef Training Academy: non-accredited professional development for culinary, hospitality and event-service professionals in the partner network — service standards, guest communication and allergen-awareness procedures.

opening_paragraph: Non-accredited professional development and service-standard training for culinary, hospitality and event-service professionals working with, or seeking to join, the myCHEF Dubai partner network.

new_paragraphs: Who is the Chef Training Academy for?

Culinary, hospitality and event-service professionals who work with, or want to join, the myCHEF Dubai partner network. Tell us about your role and experience, and we will confirm whether the next intake fits.

No. The academy is non-accredited professional development and service-standard training. It is not a government-accredited qualification and it is not a substitute for any licence or certification legally required for a participant's role.

A Certificate of Completion — confirming participation in a myCHEF professional-development programme. This is not a government-accredited qualification or a substitute for any licence or certification legally required for the participant's role.

myCHEF service standards, guest communication, villa and private-residence etiquette, event-service procedures, menu and dietary-requirement communication, allergen-awareness procedures, client privacy and discretion, table presentation, complaint handling, incident escalation, partner documentation requirements and food-safety awareness.
When is the next intake, and what does it cost?
Programme availability, entry requirements, dates and fees are confirmed for each training intake. Contact us and we will share the details for the next one.
